storage: Unopened: cool, dry cupboard. After opening, close the cap tightly and keep in the fridge, using within about 2 to 3 months or as the label says (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
looksLike: A thin, pourable, pale green to yellow-green sauce in a glass or plastic bottle; sharp, sour and hot from green chilli and vinegar.
howToPick: Check a sealed bottle, a clear green-yellow colour (not dark brown), a recent best-before date and a short ingredient list (green chilli, vinegar, salt, stabiliser). Avoid bulging caps, leaks or a fizzy smell.
shelfLife: Unopened bottles generally last many months; follow the printed date (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Fresh chopped green chilli with a splash of white vinegar
